subject.scene_narrative: A woman sits calmly on a park bench, one hand resting open and offered in a welcoming gesture, a small closed notebook beside her — the same full-body flat vector language as the approved Q1 references, deliberately symbolic of a safe, trusted presence rather than any depiction of hardship.
subject.hero_prop: open welcoming palm gesture resting on the bench

subject.sensitive_handling: Treat as symbolic support only, not a depiction of hardship. Single calm figure, no distressed body language, no tears, no confrontation, no second person shown. Keep the mood calm, safe, and hopeful — an open, welcoming presence is enough.
